bug_report:
[14 regression] aarch64: ICE in simplify_context::simplify_subreg
The following code snippet (minimized with cvise from 3.5MB preprocessed source originating from thrust unittests) causes an ICE on aarch64 with g++-14, g++-15 while it is accepted by g++-13 and earlier.
Note: the code originates from thrust, not from libstdc++!

===== 1091161.cpp =====
extern "C" double copysign(double, double);
double ccosh_x;
struct type {
  double x;
  double y;
};
template <typename T> struct complex {
  complex(T, T);
  complex() = default;
  T real() { return data.x; }
  T imag() { return data.y; }
  type data;
};
void ccosh() {
  complex<double> z_;
  complex(z_.real(), z_.imag() * copysign(1.0, ccosh_x));
}
===== =====

Originally observed with g++-14 from Debian,
verified with a local build from Git branch releases/gcc-14 commit 33c38e48d80ec8dafd889864fc17b3efc6bf6e95
